events.title: Moonlight Ride
events.location: Manor Township Rail Trail, 2459 River Road, Washington Boro
events.description: Fourth Annual Manor Township Moonlight Ride on the Enola Low Grade Rail Trail to the Safe Harbor Bridge. Bring your bike and lights; ride at your own pace after brief remarks at 6:30. Free Moonlight Ride T-shirts while supplies last. Bike lights required; trail open until 9:00 PM.
